input.quote: "CORIO MARKET SEGMENT" means those customers with annual sales revenues of less than $1,000,000,000.
input.rationale: There is no covenant restricting the businesses we may operate, the products we may build or the competing offerings we may host or sell; the Exhibit D sales and marketing cooperation is expressly non-binding. The Corio Market Segment and Territory definitions limit the scope of the licence granted to us rather than restrict our business, and Section 2.10 gives us an expansion path with consent not to be unreasonably withheld — noted, but not a field-of-use restrictive covenant.

input.quote: Commerce One hereby grants to Corio a fee-bearing, perpetual and irrevocable, nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), right and license in the Territory
input.rationale: No exclusivity, sole-source or requirements obligation binds us: all licences are expressly non-exclusive and nothing bars us from procuring or hosting competing e-procurement software. The only Vendor-side restrictions (Section 2.4 referral obligations on Commerce One not to approach our Customers) run in our favour and are not flagged.
